negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-language news source dedicated to payments-sector leadership appointments was surfaced. A targeted sl query using 'imenovanje', 'nov direktor', 'plačilne institucije' returned only an executive-search marketing page, EU/ECB institutional pages and unrelated ministry appointments.
negative_findings.result_summary: Finance.si and similar business media were not reachable through search results in this pass; their paywalled archives were not confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership moves at non-bank payment employers may only be discoverable via LinkedIn (ToS-blocked) and AJPES court-register publications, leaving a media-confirmation gap.

negative_findings.description: 'Settle' in the cell brief maps to Settle Group, identified in results as a Norwegian VC-backed fintech, not a Slovenian entity. No Slovenian Settle payments employer was confirmed, and no Slovenian careers surface was found for 'Trustee' either.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two named seed actors could not be tied to a verified Slovenian employer presence in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's actor map needs correction before crawlers are pointed at non-existent or foreign entities; the Settle/Halcom pairing in the brief may be a conflation.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated careers/zaposlitev page was located for Paywiser, Eligma/GoCrypto, or Trustee despite a combined sl-language query. Only a Facebook page, a startup.si profile, LinkedIn personal profiles and press coverage surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Smaller Slovenian PSP/EMI actors appear to hire without a persistent public careers URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hiring at the smaller, faster-moving end of the payments landscape will be invisible to a careers-page-only crawler and must be caught via aggregators, AJPES and manual LinkedIn review.

negative_findings.description: 'Nexi Slovenia' appears under several legal/brand lineages (ex-Plačilni sistemi d.o.o., Mercury Processing Services International, Nexi Croatia/nexi.hr company-data pages, Nexi Central Europe a.s.). No single canonical Slovenian legal entity name and registration number was established in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Brand-to-legal-entity mapping for the largest processor group in the cell is unresolved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without the canonical entity name/matična številka, AJPES and eObjave monitoring for leadership and org changes cannot be reliably targeted.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn and Glassdoor — the two richest surfaces for leadership moves and reorganizations at these non-bank employers — are both auth/registration-walled and prohibit automated collection in their terms.
negative_findings.result_summary: Highest-signal sources are legally unavailable for automated collection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Workstream A5 will depend on manual analyst review or a licensed data provider for its single best leadership-move signal.

coverage_gaps.description: The full licensed population of Slovenian payment institutions and e-money institutions has not been enumerated — only sample entities (Paywiser, mBills) were confirmed from the Banka Slovenije registers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch and parse the BSI register-subjektov-nadzora index plus the dedicated EMI register to produce a complete actor list with legal names, then join to AJPES for registration numbers and representatives.

coverage_gaps.description: Acquirers, POS/terminal estate operators and ATM operators in Slovenia (beyond Bankart) were not searched — e.g. independent ATM deployers, merchant-acquiring arms, terminal service providers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run sl queries on 'pridobitelj/acquiring', 'POS terminali vzdrževanje', 'bankomati upravljanje' plus company-register activity codes to surface this employer layer.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian business and tech media were not directly reached: Finance.si, STA, Računalniške novice, Delo, Bankirai/Bančni vestnik were not confirmed as accessible sources for appointment news.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch each publication's site directly and test for a payments/fintech tag feed or RSS; assess paywall depth and whether a subscription is warranted.

coverage_gaps.description: Only Workable was identified as an ATS in use. Which ATS each cell actor runs (Greenhouse, Lever, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Teamtailor, SAP SuccessFactors for Nexi) is unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each actor, inspect the careers page's network calls to identify the ATS and its JSON endpoint — structured, stable and far cheaper to poll than HTML.

coverage_gaps.description: Local terms were used for careers, register and appointment concepts, but not for acquiring/scheme-migration role vocabulary (e.g. 'ISO 20022 migracija', 'kartično poslovanje', 'procesni center', 'vodja razvoja plačil').
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the sl glossary with card/scheme operational vocabulary and re-run job-board searches using it, so role-level scheme signals are not missed.

coverage_gaps.description: MojeDelo.com, Zaposlitev.info, Deloglasnik, Kariera, Competo and Rekruter were named by ZRSZ but their per-company URL patterns for the cell's actors were not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve each portal's company-page URL pattern for the confirmed actor list and add the highest-yield two or three to the crawl set.

brief: Slovenia's payments-first employer landscape has a clear three-tier source structure: a regulator layer (Banka Slovenije registers of plačilne institucije and družbe za izdajo elektronskega denarja) that authoritatively enumerates who exists, a statutory company layer (AJPES ePRS and eObjave) that records leadership and organizational changes before any press coverage, and a thin first-party careers layer concentrated in the few large processors — Bankart (national processor, BIPS/Flik), Halcom (payments software, split across Halcom d.d. and Halcom plačila d.o.o.), Nexi/Mercury (Ljubljana and Koper) and Bitstamp. Below that tier, smaller PSPs and EMIs such as Paywiser, mBills and Eligma/GoCrypto largely lack persistent careers pages, so their hiring is only visible through Slovenian aggregators (Optius, BetterCareer, ZRSZ) and university notice boards, which double as an early-warning channel for graduate-pipeline build-up. The binding constraint is that the two richest leadership-move surfaces, LinkedIn and Glassdoor, are auth-walled and forbid automated collection — so A5 must lean on AJPES court-register publications for verified appointments and reserve LinkedIn for manual analyst review.
